finding: PR #2393's census (merged 2026-09-21) identified checklistinsider ingest defects (tagged checklistinsider-2026-08-27/-08-29/-08-30, plus bccp and catalog-explode-actuals-*) that wrote AUTOGRAPH-set cards as isAuto=false for verified always-auto product-years. This list covers baseball 2026 bowman-mega, prefixes BMA-/RMA-. Each listed id (1) carries a defective-tag source, (2) ends :no-auto..., (3) has a TWIN at the same address with :auto instead of :no-auto, matching player/cardNumber/parallel/print-run, sourced from a non-defective tag, and (4) has zero resident sold_comps sales. Rows failing (3) or (4) are excluded and tallied below, not listed.
ordering: CATALOG ONLY. This list retires the no-auto duplicate rows; the already-present :auto twin at each address is the surviving canonical row. No reslug is needed and nothing is minted.
rulings: CF-UNSIGNED-MINT-DEFECT (PR #2393, 2026-09-21). Verified always-auto (sport,year,setKey,prefix) scope for this list: baseball 2026 bowman-mega BMA-/RMA-.

SCOPE MEASURED READ-ONLY, PER ID. card_catalog WHERE sport="baseball" AND year=2026 AND setKey="bowman-mega" AND isAuto=false, filtered to ids matching the scoped prefixes and ending :no-auto. 1290 such rows exist in this (sport,year,setKey); of these, 1260 carry a defective-tag source and were fully verified (source, twin, sales); the remainder carry a non-defective source and are correctly out of scope for this repair (they are not evidence of the checklistinsider-layout defect).

VERIFICATION IS PER-ID, READ-ONLY, ALL FOUR CRITERIA REQUIRED. (1) source is one of the defective tags; (2) id ends :no-auto...; (3) a TWIN exists at the same id with :no-auto -> :auto, matching sport/year/setKey/cardNumber/parallel/num-N, source NOT defective, player matching; (4) zero resident sold_comps sales (checked by hobbyiqCardId = id and cardId = id). 509 of 1260 verified candidates passed all four and are listed. 678 failed (3) -- reason breakdown: {"no twin row at :auto id":678}. 73 failed (4) and are reported in census.salesResidentDetail, not listed.

RETIRE IS A DELETE in this lane (catalogVisibility.ts:23-25 -- every state is matchable, only visibility is tiered), and retireCatalogRow re-points nothing. Graded children were not found on any listed row in this set's scope; none are named here.

THE COST, STATED. 73 sold_comps sales sit on no-auto addresses this repair would otherwise retire; they are reported, not moved -- see census.salesResidentAtRetiredAddresses. A future sale-moving pass can re-point them onto the surviving :auto twin. Source-tagged counts for the listed rows: {"checklistinsider-2026-08-27":509}.
